description: A camper-van journey runs from Galicia and the Basque Country through Rioja, Catalonia, Valencia and La Mancha to Extremadura and Andalusia, with Rick using regional food, wine and local cooks to show why Spain behaves more like a collection of cuisines than one.

s05e00.description: Rick turns the journey's Spanish flavours into a Christmas feast, preparing clams with serrano ham and sherry, lamb with aubergines, saffron chicken with pine nuts and orange caramel creams, with José Pizarro and Maria Jose Sevilla joining the celebrations.

s05e01.description: Rick begins a camper-van journey through Spain's Atlantic north, following the seafood of Galicia and Asturias through Gijón and into the Basque Country while testing how strongly landscape still dictates regional cooking.

s05e02.description: Moving east, Rick crosses Rioja and Navarra into Catalonia and the Mediterranean, meeting cooks and producers whose wine, vegetables, meat and hospitality resist any single idea of Spanish food.

s05e03.description: Catalan and Valencian food leads Rick through Sueca and the rice country before he turns inland across La Mancha, tracing paella, wine and rustic dishes through landscapes associated with El Cid and Don Quixote.

s05e04.description: Extremadura supplies smoked pimentón and Ibérico ham before Rick heads through Guadalupe to Seville's tapas bars and flamenco culture, finishing the main journey among the Moorish echoes of Granada.
